canon_rules: Setting: circa 2036, ~5 years after the modern collapse; recognisably contemporary, scarcity-driven, not generic cyberpunk

Six playable domains map to canon identities: cipher (fifth identity, not an elemental domain), wind, water, fire, earth (the four elemental domains), dark (forbidden 26th ability / sixth Dark spirit)
25 original ability modules, 5 per elemental domain; modules can be stolen, recovered, transferred or shared
Spirits are intelligent agents with their own consent; they are never obedient buttons
The ancient catastrophe and the modern collapse (~2031) are distinct events; towers regulate environmental systems and their restoration is never a planetary reset
The system virus grew from the Kael family's failed secret extension project (target 30 abilities, stopped at the 26th); the endgame is the Rebind requiring willing spirit cooperation
Ajaye's green Cipher Sleeve appears on ONE arm only; never both, never mirrored
Power has cost: finite Sleeve energy, host condition and spirit activity are three distinct interacting factors
session_rules: Every session reads memory/ chapters first (start at memory/00-index.md, follow memory/01-session-protocol.md)
One system per build: build, npm test, commit, update memory, then start the next
New systems are plug-and-play modules auto-scanned from server/modules/ and public/src/modules/ — small files (<150 lines), one job, novice-friendly; never edit the master to add a feature
Canon is law: lore/ + memory/02-universe-canon.md; raise conflicts, never invent lore
Save state after every build (memory/05-work-state.md + this ledger) so interruptions never lose work

Status effects: slow, haste, burn, plus a timed shield window; Bulwark walls are destructible and block projectiles
Downed/respawn loop: kill credit, combat:hit / combat:down / combat:respawn events consumed by the client for feedback
Rust Warden PvE drones: patrol/wander, aggro ring, chase, hostile server-resolved fire, shared damageableTargets list, 9s respawn, XP + skill point payout, minimap markers and kill feed entries
Swept-path projectile collision so fast shots no longer tunnel through targets
Domination mode: relays captured by standing uncontested, mixed factions freeze capture, held relays score per second, capture XP, per-arena score limits and tower reset, faction scoreboard

Progression: single applyXp funnel (warden kills, player kills, relay captures, Core points, archive echoes), XP curve in server/progression.js (xpForLevel/levelFromXp, level cap 40), each level grants a skill point and +10 max HP, level:up broadcast, HUD level/XP bar, persisted XP and level

Plug-and-play server module system: server/module-loader.js auto-scans server/modules/*.js at boot with a shared context (hook-bus events joining/joined/left/persist/tick, registerSocket, route, distance, applyXp, persistPlayer, xpScale); broken modules are skipped, never fatal

Archive story terminals (Roadmap #10, COMPLETE): server module archive-terminals.js (3 canon-lore terminals, once-per-operative XP + core bounty, terminalsRead persisted) + client module terminals.js (beacons, READ prompt on F/Y/touch, lore log panel); interact key bound in keyboard, gamepad and touch input

Plug-and-play client module system: public/src/plugin-host.js hook bus + public/src/module-runner.js fetching /api/client-modules (server rescans per request), parallel import then priority-ordered setup with loading-screen progress callbacks; renderer emits render:world / render:fx / render:overlay hooks
Boot priority ordering: server and client modules may declare priority (lower boots first, default 50) so boot order is deterministic and optimisable
Loading screen boot status: title screen shows real module boot progress via #boot-status, fed by the module runner
World decoration module (world-decor.js): deterministic ruin props and named landmark labels drawn under moving entities
Combat juice module (roadmap #11, COMPLETE): combat-juice.js draws hit sparks, floating damage numbers, afterimages and proximity screenshake from server combat events

dev_notes: SESSION BOOTSTRAP: read memory/00-index.md first and follow memory/01-session-protocol.md (one system per build, plug-and-play modules only, save state after each build). Client is split into small browser ES modules under public/src/ (assetLoader, audioManager, camera, characterRenderer, config, inputManager, interpolation, keybinds, menu, menu-pages, netcode, renderer, uiManager, world). public/client.js is the master orchestrator. Server logic lives in server.js with pure helpers extracted to server/ (progression.js, shop-catalog.js, skill-tree.js). Procedural rendering remains active when optional files under public/assets/ are absent; regenerate baked sprites with 'npm run sprites'. The top-centre stat card lives in public/src/hud.js and has two layouts (full 330x64 desktop card, compact 48px phone card) chosen from the #hud-center DOM slot; never reintroduce fixed HUD pixel heights. All HUD/menu measurements come from :root variables in public/index.html (--radar-*, --hud-*, --joy, --tap*, env() safe areas), so mobile sizing is tuned in one place. Every zone in server/zones-catalog.js declares a `biome` (grass, wasteland, water, earth, fire, wind, cipher, arena); public/src/biomes.js paints them and renderer.js caches one background canvas per biome + world size, so never hardcode floor colours in renderer.js — add a painter and a biome tag instead. Factions use the existing domain field: server/modules/player-customisation.js resolves the join payload's `faction` into energyColor/color/accent and owns the suit palette; palette ids/hexes must be mirrored in server/player-palettes.js and public/src/config.js (a test enforces parity), and the cosmetic overlay lives in public/src/characterRenderer.js. MENU pages live in public/src/menu-pages.js: Character is stats/identity, Inventory owns the paperdoll and equipped gear, Skills holds core upgrades plus the tree; server/skill-tree.js owns node validation and skillBonuses(), which server/sim/abilities.js and the dash handler apply so unlocked nodes change gameplay. Tests run with 'npm test' (node --test) against a scratch profile file (PROFILE_FILE from tools/profile-scratch.js), so persisted credits/HP never leak between runs; and cover abilities, wardens, objectives, progression, camera, interpolation, renderer, sprites, modules, skill-tree bonuses and the server. Ajaye's segmented Cipher Sleeve is rendered on his anatomical left arm only; his right arm remains ordinary clothing and skin. Universe canon lives in lore/ (see lore/README.md): any new lore-bearing content (terminal logs, item names, abilities, characters) must fit those documents, and canon conflicts are raised with the project owner rather than silently resolved.
